source_text: Historica narratio hiemis et veris parum consequens est; cuncta ad spiritalem intelligentiam transferenda. Hiems animae: passionum fluctus et vitiorum procellae. In hieme sermo Dei non foras exitum hortatur, sed intramuralem munitionem. Ver animae: quies et tranquillitas; tunc Verbum vocat ut exeat extra carnem et mundum.
pass_a_gloss: Historical narration of-winter and of-spring little consistent is; all-things toward spiritual understanding to-be-transferred. Winter of-soul: of-passions waves and of-vices storms. In winter word of-God not outdoors going-out urges, but within-walls fortification. Spring of-soul: quiet and calm; then Word calls that she-may-go-out beyond flesh and world.
pass_b_english: The historical telling of winter and spring is of little consequence; everything must be carried over to spiritual understanding. The soul’s winter is the waves of passions and the storms of vices. In winter God’s Word does not urge going outdoors, but fortifying within the walls. The soul’s spring is quiet and calm; then the Word calls her to go out beyond flesh and world.
